subject: Billing orchestration: designate invoice originator + delivery for pilot entitlements
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <ap@harborbio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Manish Kulkarni <m.kulkarni@harborbio.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice delivery & generator for consolidated pilot

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the demo last week. We're ready to move a small pilot (3 entities) onto Redwood but need clarity on who 'issues' the invoice for consolidated monthly billing and how you'll deliver copies to our AP. A few constraints from our side:

- We require the original invoice to reference a single originator for tax purposes (we can accept Redwood as issuer or have Harbor Bio sign).
- AP needs both: (a) a machine-readable XML for our ERP, and (b) a human-readable PDF copy emailed to ap@harborbio.com.
- For a subset of POs (exceptions), our buyers require an emailed PDF to specific PO contacts rather than portal-only.

Can Redwood do a portal push + simultaneous email copy per invoice? If not, what's the recommended hybrid?

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Accounts Payable — Harbor Bio

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <ap@harborbio.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & generator for consolidated pilot

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the clear constraints. Short answer: yes, we can support a hybrid for the pilot. High level options —

1) Redwood-originated invoice (recommended): Redwood signs and issues a consolidated invoice. We push XML to your ERP endpoint and also send an emailed PDF copy to ap@harborbio.com and any PO-specific addresses for exceptions.

2) Harbor-originated: we hand off an XML payload and you generate/issue the PDF. This avoids changing issuer on record but requires your outbound process to stamp & send.

Naomi is cc'd to confirm technical specifics (XML schema & SFTP vs API) and Grace will own the customer success checklist.

Proposed next steps:
- Naomi to share XML schema + sample.
- We enable portal push for the pilot and configure an email fanout for PO exceptions.
- I'll send a short change-order and sample invoice for sign-off.

Would you like the PDF to be a signed Redwood invoice or an unsigned PDF for your records?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <ap@harborbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & generator for consolidated pilot

Hi Priya —

Following up with technical details and two implementation patterns we've used successfully. I've attached: sample_invoice_20261231.pdf and invoice_xml_template_V1.xml for reference.

Option A (Redwood issues & distributes) — recommended for speed:
- Redwood generates a consolidated invoice PDF that includes tax metadata and issuer information.
- We push an XML payload to your ERP endpoint (SFTP or API).
- Simultaneously we send a PDF email to ap@harborbio.com and any PO-exception addresses.
- Audit trail: invoice, signed PDF stored in portal, delivery events logged (can be exported).

Option B (Harbor issues) — when customer must remain issuer:
- We deliver canonical XML and near-final PDF as an unsigned stub.
- Harbor must sign/issue and send; Redwood provides evidence of delivery and the canonical payload.

Key questions we need from Harbor for Option A:
- XML endpoint preference: SFTP with nightly drops or REST POST?
- PO exception rule: identify by PO header (PO-level flag) or manual override list?
- Required PDF fields for your AP stamp (if any).

Relevant links: invoice XML v1 mapping: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bInvoiceSample
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.example/deal/HB-202701-02

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Billing Integrations Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_invoice_20261231.pdf (pdf), invoice_xml_template_V1.xml (xml)

---

From: Manish Kulkarni <m.kulkarni@harborbio.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <ap@harborbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & generator for consolidated pilot

Naomi —

Thanks for the options and the attachments. A couple of clarifications from AP/ERP:

- Endpoint: we prefer SFTP nightly drops for the pilot (security and batch reconciliation).
- PO exceptions: we need emailed PDF copies to the PO contact if the PO includes the flag "email-copy=true" in the header — automated routing by our system.
- Issuer: Harbor legal prefers Harbor as issuer for any invoice line that pertains to our EU subsidiaries (tax reasons). For US/ROW lines, Redwood-issuer is acceptable.

So the hybrid plan we want for pilot:
1) Redwood issues consolidated invoice for US/ROW lines; Redwood pushes XML to our SFTP and emails PDF to ap@harborbio.com.
2) For EU subsidiary lines, Redwood will push XML but mark those lines as 'harbor-origin' and we'll issue a stamped PDF. Redwood should still store and expose the consolidated PDF in the portal for visibility.

Can Redwood support line-level issuer tagging in the XML and still do the email fanout for PO-exceptions?

Best,
Manish Kulkarni
Head of AP Systems — Harbor Bio

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Manish Kulkarni <m.kulkarni@harborbio.com>, Priya Sharma <ap@harborbio.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jan 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & generator for consolidated pilot

Manish / Priya —

Thanks, this is clear and actionable. Confirming Redwood can support the requested hybrid:

- Technical: Naomi's team will deliver SFTP nightly XML drops. We'll include a per-line issuer tag and a line-level tax jurisdiction code.
- Delivery: Redwood will send the consolidated PDF to ap@harborbio.com every cycle. For POs with "email-copy=true" Redwood will fanout an extra PDF to the PO contact address you specify.
- EU lines: we'll mark those lines as 'harbor-origin' in the canonical XML; we'll also mark them in the portal UI so Harbor can select/issue the stamped PDF. Redwood will retain the unsigned consolidated PDF for audit.

Immediate next steps & owners:
- Naomi: set up SFTP credentials and post format (ETA: Jan 13).
- Manish / Priya: share the PO exception feed (sample CSV or API) and EU subsidiary tax IDs (ETA: Jan 12).
- Grace: I'll add the pilot checklist and schedule a 30-min kickoff next Wed.
- I'll circulate a short change-order that records the hybrid billing workflow and the limited scope pilot. Link to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/secure/embeddedSigning?doc=HB-MSA-2026

If that timeline works we'll plan a go-live for the month-end cycle Feb 2027.

Thanks all —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: change_order_HB_pilot_v1.pdf (will attach in next message)
